This script combines machine-learning-predicted species sensitivity with species taxonomy, genus-level phylogeny, body mass, and ecological functional groups for downstream analyses.

The script also reads chemical-use group information compiled from Kramer et al. (2024) and the Pesticide Properties Database (PPDB). It then filters the predicted sensitivity dataset to selected chemicals with known and interpretable chemical-use groups.

The final outputs are combined datasets for all taxa and for each taxonomic group: algae, invertebrates, and fish.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

# 1. Prepare chemical sensitivity data

## 1.1 Read machine-learning-predicted sensitivity

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

prediction_summary <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(predictions_ML_duration48h),

```

## 1.2 Add chemical-use groups

Each chemical was assigned to a primary use category based on information
compiled from Kramer et al. (2024) and the Pesticide Properties Database
(PPDB). Metals were excluded from this analysis.

```{r}
chem_groups_source <- read_csv(
  file = here("data/6_combined_meta_data/chem_groups.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    CAS = str_squish(CAS),
    broad_group = str_squish(use_group),
    p_sub_group = str_squish(Pesticide_sub_group)
  ) %>%
  select(CAS, broad_group, p_sub_group) %>%
  filter(!is.na(broad_group)) %>%
  filter(broad_group != "Metal")

chem_groups_source %>%
  count(broad_group, sort = TRUE) %>%
  kable()
```

## 1.3 Map PPDB pesticide types to final chemical groups

```{r}
tag_to_group <- c(
  # Arthropod control
  "Insecticide" = "arthropod-control",
  "Acaricide" = "arthropod-control",
  "Miticide" = "arthropod-control",
  "Larvicide" = "arthropod-control",
  "Termiticide" = "arthropod-control",
  "Insect Growth Regulator" = "arthropod-control",
  
  # Plant control
  "Herbicide" = "plant-control",
  "Plant Growth Regulator" = "plant-control",
  "Plant Growth Regulator precursor" = "plant-control",
  "Desiccant" = "plant-control",
  "Defoliant" = "plant-control",
  "Graminicide" = "plant-control",
  
  # Microorganism control
  "Fungicide" = "microbial-control",
  "Microbiocide" = "microbial-control",
  "Algicide" = "microbial-control",
  "bacteria" = "microbial-control",
  "bacteria, fungi" = "microbial-control",
  
  # Nematode control
  "Nematicide" = "nematode-control",
  
  # Mollusc control
  "Molluscicide" = "mollusc-control",
  
  # Fish / vertebrate control pesticide types
  "Rodenticide" = "fish-vertebrate-control",
  "Avicide" = "fish-vertebrate-control",
  "Piscicide" = "fish-vertebrate-control",
  "Lampricide" = "fish-vertebrate-control",
  
  # Veterinary antiparasitic / drug
  "Veterinary substance" = "veterinary-drug",
  "Crop antibiotic" = "veterinary-drug",
  
  # Repellent / chemical signals
  "Repellent" = "repellent-signal",
  "Semiochemical" = "repellent-signal",
  "Attractant" = "repellent-signal",
  
  # Fumigant / soil sterilant
  "Fumigant" = "fumigant-soil-sterilant",
  "Soil sterilant" = "fumigant-soil-sterilant",
  
  # Auxiliary groups
  "Metabolite" = "auxiliary",
  "Adjuvant" = "auxiliary"
)

map_subgroup_to_target <- function(x, tag_to_group) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || str_squish(x) == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  tags <- str_split(x, pattern = ";", simplify = FALSE)[[1]] %>%
    str_squish()
  
  # Ignore non-informative labels
  tags <- tags[tags != "Other substance"]
  
  # If nothing remains after removing "Other substance"
  if (length(tags) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Shortcut: original label "Mixed"
  if (length(tags) == 1 && identical(tags, "Mixed")) {
    return("mixed-target")
  }
  
  groups_all <- unique(na.omit(unname(tag_to_group[tags])))
  
  main_groups <- setdiff(groups_all, "auxiliary")
  has_auxiliary <- "auxiliary" %in% groups_all
  
  if (length(main_groups) == 0 && !has_auxiliary) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  if (length(main_groups) == 0 && has_auxiliary) {
    return("auxiliary")
  }
  
  if (length(main_groups) == 1) {
    return(main_groups[1])
  }
  
  if (length(main_groups) > 1) {
    return("mixed-target")
  }
  
  return(NA_character_)
}

chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>%
  mutate(
    p_sub_group = str_replace_all(p_sub_group, "Insectiicde", "Insecticide"),
    p_target_group = map_chr(
      p_sub_group,
      map_subgroup_to_target,
      tag_to_group = tag_to_group
    )
  )
```

Only pesticide classes with sufficient representation and clear target-control interpretation were retained.

```{r select-final-chemical-groups}
keep_pesticide <- chem_groups_source %>%
  filter(broad_group == "Pesticide") %>%
  filter(
    p_target_group %in% c(
      "arthropod-control",
      "microbial-control",
      "plant-control",
      "mixed-target"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(CAS)

chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>%
  filter(broad_group != "Pesticide" | CAS %in% keep_pesticide) %>%
  mutate(
    final_group = case_when(
      broad_group == "Industrial Chemical" ~ "Industrial_Chemical",
      broad_group == "Pharmaceutical" ~ "Pharmaceutical",
      p_target_group == "arthropod-control" ~ "P_Arthropod_control",
      p_target_group == "microbial-control" ~ "P_Microbial_control",
      p_target_group == "plant-control" ~ "P_Plant_control",
      p_target_group == "mixed-target" ~ "P_Mixed_target",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(final_group))

chemical_group_summary <- chem_groups_source %>%
  summarise(
    n_CAS = n_distinct(CAS),
    .by = final_group
  ) %>%
  arrange(final_group)

kable(chemical_group_summary)
```

The final chemical-use groups are industrial chemicals, pharmaceuticals,
arthropod-control pesticides, plant-control pesticides, microbial-control
pesticides, and mixed-target pesticides.

```{r filter-predictions-to-selected-chemicals}
sensitivity_subCAS <- predictions_ML_duration48h %>%
  filter(CAS %in% chem_groups_source$CAS) %>%
  left_join(
    chem_groups_source %>%
      select(CAS, final_group),
    by = "CAS"
  ) %>%
  rename(chem_group = final_group)

selected_prediction_summary <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(sensitivity_subCAS),
  n_species = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS$species),
  n_CAS = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS$CAS),
  n_chem_groups = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS$chem_group)
)

kable(selected_prediction_summary)
```

## 1.4 Correct species names in the sensitivity dataset

```{r}
correct_latin_names <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(str_to_lower(as.character(x)))
  
  case_when(
    x == "lithodes antarcticus" ~ "lithodes antarctica",
    x == "viviparus bengalensis" ~ "filopaludina bengalensis",
    x == "acanthomysis sculpta" ~ "holmesimysis sculpta",
    x == "acartia clausi" ~ "acartia clausii",
    x == "acartia lillgeborgi" ~ "acartia lilljeborgii",
    x == "acheilognathus moriokae" ~ "acheilognathus melanogaster",
    x == "achnanthes minutissima" ~ "achnanthidium minutissimum",
    x == "nuria danrica" ~ "esomus danrica",
    x == "oreochromis mossambicus x urolepis" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus",
    x == "oreochromis mossambicus x niloticus" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus",
    x == "enteromorpha intestinalis" ~ "ulva intestinalis",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

sensitivity_subCAS <- sensitivity_subCAS %>%
  mutate(latin = correct_latin_names(species)) %>%
  distinct()

kable(
  tibble(
    n_species_after_name_correction = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS$latin),
    n_CAS = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS$CAS)
  )
)
```

# 2. Read species taxonomy, phylogeny, body mass, and functional groups

```{r}
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG <- readRDS(
  here("data/6_combined_meta_data/spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG.rds")
)

spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG %>%
  mutate(
    latin = str_squish(str_to_lower(latin)),
    genus = str_squish(str_to_lower(genus)),
    group = str_squish(str_to_lower(group)),
    group = case_when(
      group %in% c("fish", "vertebrate") ~ "fish",
      TRUE ~ group
    ),
    log_mass = log10(mean_mass_g),
    log_mass_c = as.numeric(scale(log_mass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
  )

trait_summary <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(latin),
    n_genus = n_distinct(genus),
    n_FG2 = n_distinct(FG2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(trait_summary)
```

# 3. Filter predicted sensitivity to species with available trait data

Predicted sensitivity values are retained only for species with taxonomy,
phylogeny, body mass, and functional group information. When duplicate
predictions exist for the same species, chemical, and chemical-use group, the
mean predicted value is used.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dt <- as.data.table(sensitivity_subCAS)

sensitivity_subCAS_filter <- dt[
  latin %in% spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG$latin,
  .(
    predicted = mean(predicted, na.rm = TRUE),
    species = first(species)
  ),
  by = .(latin, CAS, chem_group)
] %>%
  as_tibble()

filtered_prediction_summary <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(sensitivity_subCAS_filter),
  n_species = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS_filter$latin),
  n_CAS = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS_filter$CAS),
  n_chem_groups = n_distinct(sensitivity_subCAS_filter$chem_group)
)

kable(filtered_prediction_summary)
```

# 4. Combine predicted sensitivity with species traits

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens <- sensitivity_subCAS_filter %>%
  left_join(
    spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG,
    by = "latin"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_sensi = predicted,
    sensi = 10^log_sensi
  ) %>%
  select(-predicted)

combined_summary <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens),
  n_species = n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$latin),
  n_genus = n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$genus),
  n_CAS = n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$CAS),
  n_chem_groups = n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$chem_group)
)

kable(combined_summary)
```

## 4.1 Harmonise functional group labels

This section creates broader functional group labels for downstream analysis.
Invertebrate groups are prefixed with `I_`, fish groups are prefixed with `F_`,
and arthropod invertebrates are additionally marked with `_A`.

```{r create-functional-group-variables}
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens %>%
  mutate(
    FG3 = case_when(
      group == "algae" ~ FG2,
      group == "invertebrate" ~ paste0("I_", FG2),
      group == "fish" ~ paste0("F_", FG2),
      TRUE ~ FG2
    ),
    FG4 = str_replace_all(FG3, "\\s*,\\s*", ",")
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(FG4, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(
    FG4 = str_trim(FG4),
    FG4 = if_else(
      group == "invertebrate" & !str_starts(FG4, "I_"),
      paste0("I_", FG4),
      FG4
    ),
    FG4 = if_else(
      group == "fish" & !str_starts(FG4, "F_"),
      paste0("F_", FG4),
      FG4
    ),
    FG4 = str_replace_all(FG4, "\\s*/\\s*", "_"),
    FG4 = str_squish(FG4),
    FG4 = if_else(
      FG4 %in% c("F_Detritivore_Herbivore", "F_Herbivore", "F_Detritivore"),
      "F_Detritivore_Herbivore",
      FG4
    ),
    FFG = if_else(
      phylum == "arthropoda",
      paste0(FG4, "_A"),
      FG4
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct()

FFG_summary <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens %>%
  count(group, FFG, sort = TRUE)

kable(FFG_summary)
```

## 4.2 Calculate relative sensitivity

Because absolute chemical sensitivity varies strongly among chemicals, species
sensitivity is standardised within each chemical using *Daphnia magna* as the
reference species. Relative sensitivity is calculated as the ratio between each
species' predicted sensitivity and the predicted sensitivity of *Daphnia magna*
for the same chemical. The response variable is the log10-transformed relative
sensitivity.

```{r}
ref_sensitivity <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens %>%
  filter(latin == "daphnia magna") %>%
  distinct(latin, CAS, chem_group, sensi) %>%
  group_by(CAS) %>%
  summarise(
    ref_sensi = mean(sensi, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens %>%
  left_join(ref_sensitivity, by = "CAS") %>%
  mutate(
    rel_sensi = sensi / ref_sensi,
    log_rel_sensi = log10(rel_sensi)
  )

n_missing_reference <- sum(is.na(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$ref_sensi))

spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(log_mass),
    !is.na(log_rel_sensi),
    is.finite(log_rel_sensi)
  )

relative_sensitivity_summary <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens),
  n_species = n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$latin),
  n_CAS = n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$CAS),
  n_missing_reference_before_filtering = n_missing_reference
)

kable(relative_sensitivity_summary)
```

# 5. Check tree alignment and save outputs

## 5.1 Full dataset

```{r save-full-dataset}
full_tree <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined_meta_data/full_genus_tree.rds"))

full_tree_check <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "n_genus_in_dataset",
    "n_tips_in_full_tree",
    "genus_in_tree_not_dataset",
    "genus_in_dataset_not_tree"
  ),
  value = c(
    n_distinct(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$genus),
    length(full_tree$tip.label),
    length(setdiff(full_tree$tip.label, unique(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$genus))),
    length(setdiff(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens$genus), full_tree$tip.label))
  )
)

kable(full_tree_check)

saveRDS(
  spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens,
  file = here("data/6_combined_meta_data/full_mass_FFG_sens.rds")
)
```

## 5.2 Taxon-specific datasets

```{r save-taxon-specific-datasets}
save_taxon_dataset <- function(dat, taxon, tree_file, output_file) {
  
  dat_taxon <- dat %>%
    filter(group == taxon)
  
  genus_tree <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined_meta_data", tree_file))
  
  check_tbl <- tibble(
    group = taxon,
    n_rows = nrow(dat_taxon),
    n_CAS = n_distinct(dat_taxon$CAS),
    n_species = n_distinct(dat_taxon$latin),
    n_genus = n_distinct(dat_taxon$genus),
    n_FFG = n_distinct(dat_taxon$FFG),
    n_tree_tips = length(genus_tree$tip.label),
    genus_in_tree_not_dataset = length(setdiff(genus_tree$tip.label, unique(dat_taxon$genus))),
    genus_in_dataset_not_tree = length(setdiff(unique(dat_taxon$genus), genus_tree$tip.label))
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    dat_taxon,
    file = here("data/6_combined_meta_data", output_file)
  )
  
  check_tbl
}

algae_check <- save_taxon_dataset(
  dat = spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens,
  taxon = "algae",
  tree_file = "algae_genus_tree.rds",
  output_file = "algae_mass_FFG_sens.rds"
)

invertebrate_check <- save_taxon_dataset(
  dat = spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens,
  taxon = "invertebrate",
  tree_file = "invertebrate_genus_tree.rds",
  output_file = "invertebrate_mass_FFG_sens.rds"
)

fish_check <- save_taxon_dataset(
  dat = spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens,
  taxon = "fish",
  tree_file = "fish_genus_tree.rds",
  output_file = "fish_mass_FFG_sens.rds"
)

taxon_output_summary <- bind_rows(
  algae_check,
  invertebrate_check,
  fish_check
)

kable(taxon_output_summary)
```

# 6. Final summary

```{r final-summary}
final_summary <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG_sens %>%
  group_by(group, chem_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(latin),
    n_genus = n_distinct(genus),
    n_CAS = n_distinct(CAS),
    n_FFG = n_distinct(FFG),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, chem_group)

kable(final_summary)
```
